title: How Is Inflation Measured in India? CPI and WPI Explained With the New Base Year
seoTitle: How Is Inflation Measured in India? CPI and WPI Explained
seoDescription: India measures inflation with CPI (MoSPI, base 2024) and WPI (DPIIT, base 2022-23). New weights, RBI's 4% target and how to read the latest data.
excerpt: The new CPI and WPI series in plain words: what goes into the basket, why food now weighs less, how the RBI's 2-6% band works, and a step-by-step reading of the October 2026 numbers, plus how to estimate your own inflation.
